items.title: New BlueNoroff Campaign Uses Fileless PowerShell and AI-Generated Zoom Lures
items.description: A dangerous new cyber campaign from North Korea’s Lazarus Group is targeting cryptocurrency and Web3 professionals using fake Zoom meeting interfaces, fileless PowerShell scripts, and AI-generated deepfake content. The group behind this activity is BlueNoroff, a financially motivated subgroup known for stealing digital assets. This campaign has spread across more than 20 countries, with the […]…
